import torch
import torch.nn as nn

model = nn.Linear(4, 1)

criterion = nn.MSELoss()

x = torch.randn(10, 4)

y = torch.randn(10, 1)

predictions = model(x)

data_loss = criterion(
    predictions,
    y
)

lambda_l2 = 0.01

l2_penalty = torch.sum(
    model.weight ** 2
)

total_loss = (
    data_loss
    + lambda_l2 * l2_penalty
)

print("Data Loss:", data_loss.item())
print("Total Loss:", total_loss.item())

lambda_l1 = 0.01

l1_penalty = torch.sum(
    torch.abs(model.weight)
)

total_loss = (
    data_loss
    + lambda_l1 * l1_penalty
)

print("Data Loss:", data_loss.item())
print("Total Loss:", total_loss.item())

optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(
    model.parameters(),
    lr=0.01,
    weight_decay=0.01
)
